## Episode Thesis

The guest is memory champion Jonas von Essen, and the episode is a non-market conversation about the risks of AI. He warns that AI could slip out of human control, that the alignment problem is unsolved, and that the labour market could be upended fast. A host adds that AI is soaking up huge amounts of capital, including from bond markets and energy assets, which could backfire if the productivity gains don't arrive. No stock recommendations were made, and the guest says he only holds global index funds.
